['Alltours Flugreisen GmbH '].company_description: Alltours Flugreisen GmbH operates as a travel company offering a wide range of vacation destinations and packages, including all-inclusive vacations, family vacations, and single vacations. The company provides a variety of travel options and has a strong brand presence, with a focus on providing high-quality vacations at affordable prices.

['Funke Mediengruppe GmbH & Co. KGaA '].company_description: Funke Mediengruppe (formerly WAZ-Mediengruppe) is Germany's third largest newspaper and magazine publisher with a total of over 500 publications in eight countries. The group's largest paper is Westdeutsche Allgemeine Zeitung, the largest newspaper in the Ruhr metropolitan region. Other properties in Germany include the TV magazine Gong and the woman's magazine Die Aktuelle. Besides Germany, Funke Mediengruppe has publications in Austria, Hungary, Croatia, Albania, and Russia. The company formed Media Print Macedonia and owns several newspapers and magazines in Macedonia. It also partially owns the Austrian Kronen Zeitung and Kurier. In 2013, Funke acquired several papers and magazines, including Berliner Morgenpost, Hamburger Abendblatt, Bild der Frau, and Hörzu, from Axel Springer AG.
